page.overview:
What is I'll Cry Instead?

I'll Cry Instead is a song by The Beatles (credited to Lennon/McCartney). It was composed by John Lennon for the film A Hard Day's Night and was included on the album of the same name. It orginally was going to be in the film, but was replaced by "Can't Buy Me Love."
